title: Agent moderation (kick, remove, ban, unban, role change) and its JMAP Chat mapping: ChatBan/set and kickMembers
description:
Bead mimid-90cd: room moderation from mimid-agent (kick, remove, ban, unban, role change), which the default admin role allows (decision mimid-1wgh.56), and its JMAP Chat face.

Agent operations (mimid-agent-core), each one Commit by the acting device, through Room/update; the hub's room policy decides (room-policy-04 §8.1.2, §8.1.3). Each acts on another user, never on the actor (§8.1.2 canRemoveParticipant and canKick: "another"; §8.1.3 canChangeUserRole: "but not itself").
1. kick(room, user): MLS Removes of every leaf of the user, participant list unchanged (canKick). A user with no leaf cannot be kicked.
2. remove(room, user): participant_list removedIndices = the user, and the Removes of all its leaves in the same Commit (canRemoveParticipant: "There MUST NOT be any clients of the removed user in the MLS group after the corresponding commit").
3. ban(room, user): participant_list changedRoleParticipants = (user, role 1), and the Removes (§8.1.3 canBan: "changes the target user's role to ... banned ... and removes all the banned user's clients"). Only a user in the participant list; banning a user who is not there (an add straight to role 1) is not offered. Refused locally when role 1 is not named "banned".
4. unban(room, user): role 1 to role 2, the role mimid-agent gives every participant it adds (canUnban). No clients are added: §8.1.3 "Adding clients for that unbanned user is not authorized by this capability". The user's devices do not rejoin by themselves (join_own_rooms never retries a room the device knows, decision mimid-1wgh.61 item 1): an admin removes the user and invites them again, or a new device of the user joins by external Commit (canAddOwnClient). Readings for the target role: (a) always 2; (b) a role the caller names. Chosen (a) for the Agent method, matching what invite gives; change_role then moves it on.
5. change_role(room, user, role_index): changedRoleParticipants = (user, role_index), for a non-zero role other than 1 (bans go through ban, which also removes the clients).
6. invite of a user already in the participant list stays refused locally ("already a participant"), banned or not; the hub refuses it too (a ParticipantListUpdate adding a user already listed is invalid, protocol-07 §7.5).

JMAP Chat (mimid-agent-jmap), as draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 models a group Chat:
7. Chat/set removeMembers of another member is remove (2). It was forbidden.
8. Chat/set updateMemberRoles maps "admin" to the room's role named "admin" and "member" to role 2 (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §ChatMember role is "admin" or "member"); it was forbidden. A room without a role named "admin" refuses "admin".
9. ChatMember.role is mirrored from the participant list at each sync: "admin" for a participant whose role is named "admin", "member" otherwise; a banned participant (role 1 "banned") is not listed. Before, the owner was admin only of a Chat it created here. crate-jmap lets only an admin send member patch keys, so the mirror is what lets an admin of a joined room moderate.
10. Kick, ban and unban have no group-Chat form in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 (SpaceBan and manage_members are Space-only, and a group Chat has no ban object). INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC: three methods under the JMAP Chat capability, Chat/kick, Chat/ban and Chat/unban, each with arguments accountId, chatId (a Chat bound to a room) and memberId (a ChatContact id), answering {accountId}. A Chat not bound to a room, an unknown contact or the owner's own id is invalidArguments; a hub refusal is a method error forbidden with the hub's description; an unreachable server serverUnavailable. They follow Message/reportAbuse (decision mimid-1wgh.58), the other invented method of the bridge. To go to the jmap-chat-spec owner (Mark) if wanted there.
11. After its own moderation Commit the agent reports an Event::MembersChanged, as for a Commit it receives, so the JMAP Chat's members follow this device's own change (the agent does not otherwise report its own Commits).
12. Found on the way: a device removed from a room kept the group's MLS state, and OpenMLS refuses a Welcome to a group it holds, so a removed or kicked user could never be invited back. The agent now deletes the group state when it is out of a room, and before joining from a Welcome deletes leftover state of a group it is not in (Member::delete).
notes:
Mark 2026-11-19: draft jmap-chat-spec text for Chat/kick, Chat/ban, Chat/unban for his review before any write.
jmap-chat-spec 516c61b: ChatBan (base draft) + Moderation/kickMembers (jmap-chat-mimi). mimid to switch Chat/kick|ban|unban to ChatBan objects and the kickMembers patch key (needs crate-jmap ChatBan type).
REVISED 2026-11-19 (bead mimid-1t3p, crate-jmap fe13c651): item 10 superseded. Chat/kick, Chat/ban, Chat/unban are removed; the spec now covers them: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §ChatBan (jmap-chat-spec 516c61b) and draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §Moderation (kickMembers). ChatBan/set create = Agent::ban (ChatBackend::create_chat_ban; the agent's one Commit replaces the default's RemoveMembers update; the ChatBan is stored under a minted id and the user dropped from members at once). destroy = Agent::unban, never re-adding clients (destroy_chat_ban); a ban the room no longer holds is only destroyed locally. update of reason/expiresAt is local only. expiresAt: sync lifts expired bans (base draft MUST), reporting a refused lift in SyncReport.problems. Chat/set kickMembers = Agent::kick per user (kick_chat_members); the owner's id or a non-contact is invalidProperties, a hub refusal forbidden. crate-jmap checks the admin role from the mirrored members first, so a member's ChatBan/set is forbidden before the hub. Item 9 holds: members mirror the participant list, so an unbanned user is listed again as member (mimi §Moderation 'gives the user the member role again') although base §ChatBan/set says lifting does not add the user back. 13 (new): ChatBans mirror the room: at each sync every participant an active room holds in role 1 'banned' has one ChatBan in its Chat, and a ChatBan whose user no longer holds the role is destroyed, so another admin's ban/unban shows here. Readings for bannedBy of a ban this account did not issue (the participant list does not record the banner; MembersChanged carries no committer and bans can predate the device's join): (a) the accountId, as the agent's own notices are sent by the accountId (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.27); (b) the Commit sender's contact when the device saw the Commit, else (a); (c) leave the ban out. Chosen (a), INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC: simplest, never names the wrong person as banner; (b) needs a committer on Event::MembersChanged and the journal, and still falls back to (a). For Mark to judge.
Correction to 13: (a) does name the owner as banner when another admin banned; the crate's Limitations say so. Chosen over (b) for now because (b) changes the agent's journal format.
